title: VTL TierTagger
description: A simple tier tagger mod for Viet TierList
body:
# VTL TierTagger

**This is a fork of the original [TierTagger](https://modrinth.com/mod/tiertagger) mod by uku (originally created by netiyiy) to display tiers from the [Viet Tierlist](tierslist.net).**

A gorgeous Minecraft Fabric mod that displays every player's tier from the **Viet tierlist** (and other supported tierlists) right in-game, like this:

> HT1 | Ooh_Netiyiy

A very small but very useful mod — you'll likely likey. :)

# NOTE: THIS MOD REQUIRED [UKULIB](https://modrinth.com/mod/ukulib) TO WORK

## Features

- Shows a player's tier next to their nametag automatically
- Supports multiple tierlists (MCTiers, SubTiers, **Viet tierlist**)
- Switch gamemodes on the fly with a keybind
- Optional icons and colors per gamemode
- Also works in the player list (TAB) and on Text Display entities

## Supported Tierlists

| Tierlist | URL | API Style |
|---|---|---|
| **Viet Tierlist** | <https://www.tierslist.net/> | Name-based lookup |
| MCTiers | <https://mctiers.com/> | UUID-based lookup |
| SubTiers | <https://subtiers.net/> | UUID-based lookup |

You can change the active tierlist in the mod's config screen (set the API URL to the one you want to use).
